about_the_game:
In this darkly comedic RPG, you play as H.P. Lovecraft’s notoriously and historically accurate named cat. Yes Lovecrafts cat in real life actually had a slur for a name. Look it up. Fed up with the legacy your owner left you — and the horrendous name he gave you. One day, you steal the Necronomicon, rip open a portal to 2025 America, and buy a gun. Your mission? Go back in time and kill Lovecraft.

But the Necronomicon doesn’t play fair. Every time you use it, it leaks eldritch horrors into the modern world. Now the streets are crawling with tentacled monstrosities, cultists with smartphones, and cosmic abominations. If you're going to survive — let alone get strong enough to defeat your former master — you'll have to fight, adapt, and grow more powerful than anything Lovecraft ever imagined.

Features:

  • 5 Acts of chaotic, satirical storytelling

  • Roughly 3–5 hours of gameplay

  • Literally THE BEST RPG Ever Made! (Not really, but it's damn close)

  • Cosmic horror meets modern absurdity

WISHLIST NOW — before someone calls you by name.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® 8.1/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL / DirectX 11+ GPU (integrated graphics OK)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 or better if using many visual effects
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: You are a cat and Lovecraft has given you a slur for a name. So you steal the Necronomicon, open a portal to 2025 America, & buy a gun. Your mission? Go back in time and kill your owner Lovecraft as an act of revenge. The problem? Necronomicon also raised cosmic abominations to protect him!
